notes: Liliana's Scorn, printed: 'Destroy target creature. You may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Liliana, Death Mage, reveal it, and put it into your hand.' Liliana, Death Mage is in your GRAVEYARD (not the library). Cast Scorn on the opponent's 2/2: it is destroyed; answer the may with fire and pick Liliana: she moves graveyard -> hand. Top Junk (the only library card besides the filler) is taken by the opening draw, so hand holds Top Junk and Liliana.
